 WNCT Greenville Follow Greenville Chick-fil-A to offer free Veterans Day boxed meals
 Pel Law Mon, November 9, 2026 at 9:44 PM UTC Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. GREENVILLE, N.C. (WNCT) -- The Chick-fil-A at University Boulevard in Greenville is set to distribute 400 free boxed meals to veterans on Wednesday.
 The giveaway will begin at 11:00 AM in the restaurant's parking lot while supplies last.
 To receive a meal, veterans must present a valid military ID, veteran ID, or equivalent credentials.
